snippet.title: Duke Nukem Forever 2011 - Unofficial Modding Tools Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the reimposition mod! 
(Weapons on the first screen means SELECTABLE weapons)

Features: 
1) Weapon limit gone. 
2) Fully selectable weapons with 0-9 buttons. 
3) New hud.
4) Unreal Editor support
5) Unreal Script compiling support
6) Content import support.
7) DOF compeletely removed from the game.
8) And more!

Come check us out!
https://github.com/jmarshall23/DNF-reimposition
